---
title: "Data loader"
---

In the single-session case, this step takes any [`RAW_DATA_PATH`](outputs.qmd#raw-data-path) or loaded [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec) as an input.

In the multi-session case, the user can pass a [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec), [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC_LIST`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec-list). If the user wants to concatenate
runs or sessions, they can do so manually at this stage. If the user wants to split the sorting based on concatenated times, 
they will need to use [`CONCAT_REC_TIMES`](outputs.qmd#concat-rec-times).

This step should provide an argument to cut down the recording for debugging (e.g. `debug=True` will take the first 3 minutes
of the recording, see [`DEBUGGING_REC`](outputs.qmd#debugging-rec)). It should provide the option for the user to pass a [`PROBE`](outputs.qmd#probe) to attach to the recording(s).

The result of this step is an in-memory [`SPIKEINTERFACE_REC`](outputs.qmd#spikeinterface-rec).  

For flexibility, this node can be 

<details>
<summary><strong>Checks</strong></summary>

- Stop if the probe cannot be loaded automatically and the user has not provided one.
- Warn when recordings intended for multi-session processing do not share compatible channel sets or sampling rates.

</details>
